Maya Patel: Quick check — I'm consolidating INC395 postmortem actions into the RCA doc. Can owners confirm they still own the items on page 3 and commit due dates? I plan to lock the doc EOD Friday so we can close the RCA.
Samir Khan: I own 'query cache eviction fix' — target EOD Tue next week. Blocker: need eng-infra approval for canary window. @eng-infra FYI.
Julio Ortega: I'm listed for 'alert-threshold tuning' — can move to Wed if Samir can do the canary earlier. Otherwise Thu. No blockers on my side.
Li Chen: I own 'dashboard + playbook' writeup. ETA Thu noon. Blocking on final logs from runtime team (PR #4123).
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary window is Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC. See /deploys for details.
Maya Patel: Samir — can you add the canary plan link in the RCA and tag eng-infra? Also include the minimal rollback commands, e.g.:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n prod-canary
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod-canary --to-revision=<prev>
```
Samir Khan: Done — added the plan and pinged @eng-infra in the doc. I can run the canary Wed 02:00 UTC. Blocker cleared.
Julio Ortega: Great, I'll move my item to Wed as well. Note: I'll need ~1h for runbook review. @Li Chen can you spare 30m right after the canary smoke?
Li Chen: Yep, 03:00 UTC works for me. I'll join the runbook check and finalize the playbook steps.
Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll mark the RCA actions tentatively: Samir -> 1749667200 (canary start), Julio -> 1749670800 (runbook review), Li -> 1749674400 (playbook finalize). If anything slips, ping here so I can update the RCA table.
Samir Khan: :thumbsup:
Julio Ortega: :white_check_mark: moving my ETA in the doc now.
Li Chen: Added a short note about logs PR #4123 and requested one extra log field from eng-runtime.
Alex Ruiz: (eng-runtime) PR merged a few mins ago and I added the extra field. No regressions seen in our internal smoke tests.
Maya Patel: Thanks — that unblocks Li and lets us keep the Wed plan. I'll do a final sweep tomorrow morning and close this action list unless new blockers show up. /cc @oncall
